headline: This law authorizes a commemorative display honoring U.S. and Allied members of the armed forces who served in the Pacific during World War II, paid for without federal funds.
what_it_does: It lets the Pacific Historic Parks set up and maintain a display to honor Pacific Theater veterans of World War II. Federal money cannot be used to design, buy, install, or maintain the display, but the National Park Service may accept and spend private contributions of money and resources for it.
when_it_takes_effect: The summary does not give a separate effective date, so it appears to take effect when the law was enacted on May 7, 2018.
